title: Signed chain-swap compatibility for a summand-normalized total-tensor comparison
statement: Let J,R and Jprime,Rprime be ringed sites, U an additive functor of their module-sheaf categories, and u a coherent underived tensor comparison [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data]. Let chain be a natural total-tensor comparison with the stated u.tensor map on every coproduct summand. Fix complexes P,Q and chain isomorphisms sB and sA exchanging their total tensor complexes, before and after U. Suppose each swap restricts on summand (p,q) to (-1)^(p*q) times the appropriate underived braiding followed by inclusion of summand (q,p). Then U applied termwise to sB followed by chain(Q,P) equals chain(P,Q) followed by sA. No flatness, localization, or preservation of coproducts is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0FPT and 06YU; chain-level signed summand calculation in the symmetry verification.

proof.text: precompose with the inverse comparison, then test every target coproduct summand. The summand law expresses its inverse as the inverse underived tensor comparison followed by the image of the source inclusion. Rewrite the source signed swap, preserve its integer scalar by additivity, and apply the underived symmetry square. Cancel the inverse tensor comparison. The target signed swap has precisely the resulting summand restriction. This proves equality of the component maps and hence of chain maps, without assuming coproduct preservation.

lean.statement:
theorem ringed_forget_tensor_chain_symmetry
    (chain : coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        coefficientTotalTensor.{s, d, vd} J' R')
    (summand : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ)
      (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
      U.map (tensorSummand.{c, v, r} J R P Q p q n hpq) ≫
        (chain.hom.app (P, Q)).f n = u.tensor.hom.app (P.X p, Q.X q) ≫
          tensorSummand.{d, vd, s} J' R' ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q n hpq)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ)
    (sB : (coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (P, Q) ≅
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (Q, P))
    (sA : (coefficientTotalTensor.{s, d, vd} J' R').obj
        ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P, (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≅
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{s, d, vd} J' R').obj
        ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q, (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (hsB : ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (h' : q + p = n),
      tensorSummand.{c, v, r} J R P Q p q n h ≫ sB.hom.f n =
        ((p * q).negOnePow : ℤ) •
          ((SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory R).toBraidedCategory.braiding
            (P.X p) (Q.X q)).hom ≫ tensorSummand.{c, v, r} J R Q P q p n h')
    (hsA : ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (h' : q + p = n),
      tensorSummand.{d, vd, s} J' R' ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q n h ≫ sA.hom.f n =
        ((p * q).negOnePow : ℤ) •
          ((SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory R').toBraidedCategory.braiding
            (U.obj (P.X p)) (U.obj (Q.X q))).hom ≫
            tensorSummand.{d, vd, s} J' R' ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
              ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) q p n h') :
    (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map sB.hom ≫ chain.hom.app (Q, P) =
      chain.hom.app (P, Q) ≫ sA.hom
